title: Audience with the Steward
text:
*You march to the Duke's estate and demand an audience with the steward. Goran receives you in a study lined with books he has never read — a small man with sharp features and restless hands.*

Goran: "Ah, the investigator. I've heard you've been busy. Asking questions, bothering honest merchants, frightening dock workers. Not exactly diplomatic behavior."

*He pours two glasses of wine and offers you one. You decline.*

Goran: "Smart. Trust no one — that's the survival instinct talking. Tell me, what have you found in your... investigations?"

*His eyes are sharp, calculating. He's fishing for information — wanting to know how much you know. Every word here is a weapon or a shield.*

choices.text: Bluff — tell him you've found nothing of interest
Accuse him directly — you know about the poison and the weapons
Play along and try to learn what he knows
